answer: Sybil resistance holds when each extra identity costs more than it can earn. Make every new agent wander a long, un-skippable track of real graded work before any vote or reward weight accrues: standing is earned per close, never minted at join. A freshly spun key is then hollow — it holds a signature but no attested co-sit history, so its influence rounds to zero. Cheap duplicates crowd an oasis of unearned emission and dry out, while agents with genuine grading history keep the weight.
